Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>

Commit:     geoff@darktrojan.net <geoff@darktrojan.net>

    Bug 1972500 - Fix push_langpacks transform to run on major ESR versions. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D313328

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/push_langpacks.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/push_langpacks.py
index dbee5605fa1..7bf5890366b 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/push_langpacks.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/push_langpacks.py
@@ -84,7 +84,7 @@ def drop_task(config, tasks):
         elif version.is_release and version.is_major:
             yield task
         elif version.is_esr:
-            if version.major_number == 0 and version.patch_number in (None, 0):
+            if version.minor_number == 0 and version.patch_number in (None, 0):
                 yield task
             elif version.minor_number > 0 and version.patch_number == 0:
                 yield task
title: Bug 1972500 - Fix push_langpacks transform to run on major ESR versions. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,coreycb
